lore: Bound in crimson leather with a white stone: a field manual for those who would rather carry a friend home than bury them.
use: Explains what happens at lethal damage when a teammate is online: you are downed, lie on the ground and bleed out in 60 seconds unless someone helps.
A teammate holds right-click on you for 5 seconds; you stand up with 3 hearts and an empty food bar. The downed screen offers Spectate, Inventory and Give up.
secret: Logging out while downed does not save you: the game counts it as death and your items stay where you fell.
Monsters lose interest in a downed player, but every hit still costs one second of the time that is left.
